name: Lark CLI
description: Execute any lark-cli command to interact with Lark/Feishu (calendar, messages, docs, base, sheets, tasks, mail, contact, wiki, and more).

binaryPath.description: Full path to the lark-cli binary. Fallback: LARK_CLI_BIN env var, then auto-detect from PATH.
